title: Walking
description: Take a comfortable walk outdoors or indoors.
tip: Start slowly and increase your walking time gradually.

title: Stretching
description: Perform gentle stretches for your arms, legs and back.
tip: Avoid bouncing or forcing a stretch.

title: Yoga
description: Try simple yoga poses and breathing exercises.
tip: Choose comfortable poses and focus on controlled breathing.

title: Cycling
description: Ride a bicycle at a comfortable speed.
tip: Wear a helmet and choose a safe cycling route.

title: Bodyweight Squats
description: Perform controlled squats using your body weight.
tip: Keep your movements controlled and use a comfortable range.

title: Deep Breathing
description: Sit comfortably and practise slow, gentle breathing.
tip: Stop if you feel dizzy or uncomfortable.
